metadata.title: Privacy Policy
metadata.description: Read how AMPARGO handles information submitted through this website.

hero.title: Privacy Policy
hero.description: This policy explains how information submitted through the AMPARGO website may be collected, used and protected.

PrivacyPage.notice: This is an initial website privacy policy and should receive legal review before final publication.

information.title: Information We Collect
information.body: When you request an estimate or contact AMPARGO, we may collect your name, phone number, email address, project address or ZIP code, project type, estimated budget, desired start date, project description and any photos or plans you choose to attach.

use.title: How We Use Information
use.body: We use submitted information to review project requests, communicate with you, prepare follow-up questions and respond about remodeling or construction services.

sharing.title: Information Sharing
sharing.body: AMPARGO does not sell personal information. Information may be shared only with service providers needed to operate the website or deliver communications after those services are approved and configured.

security.title: Security
security.body: We use reasonable administrative and technical measures intended to protect information. No website or electronic transmission can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

retention.title: Data Retention
retention.body: Information should be retained only as long as reasonably necessary to respond to a request, manage a potential project or meet legitimate operational obligations.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.body: Website analytics may be activated in the future to understand general site usage. Analytics is not loaded unless a valid measurement identifier is configured.

choices.title: Your Questions and Choices
choices.body: You may contact AMPARGO to ask about information you submitted or request an appropriate update or deletion, subject to legitimate business and recordkeeping needs.

changes.title: Policy Updates
changes.body: This policy may be updated when website features, service providers or operating practices change. The current version will be published on this page.

contact.title: Privacy Questions
contact.body: Official contact methods for privacy questions are available on the Contact page. A privacy email address has not yet been established.
